ispot-conversion: Only the documented production and staging /v2/{site}.gif routes are selected. Cookie bootstrap ps.ispot.tv and conversion CSV/API uploads remain outside this pack.

All new field, amount, forwarding and method checks are advisory. The guides describe multiple profiles and are not a complete current acceptance specification. Empty optional strings remain accepted.

Omitted app and type default to web and visit. No unconditional server IP, user-agent, cookie or datetime requirement is imposed on browser calls or a query-IP alternative. No arbitrary timestamp age window is imposed.
The conversion guide gives cid 128 characters and channel 64; the older impression table gives channel 16. Each owner retains its source-specific limits.

The five-value customdata dashboard advisory skips structured legacy object/array forms from the server guide. Their inner syntax is not parsed. High-cardinality correctness and exact escaping cannot be proven from one decoded URL.

IP syntax accepts IPv4 and IPv6 in line with later matching guidance. Original-client provenance, trusted proxies, household matching, identity partner eligibility, account ownership, configuration and delivery are external.
Amount precision follows the published decimal(7,2) table as advice, preserving signed values and leading zeros. The exact receiver numeric parser and alternative numeric spellings are unpublished.
ispot: Only production/staging /v2/{site}.gif routes are selected. Other /v2/ assets receive explicit directory coverage diagnostics.
Optional original-client IP syntax accepts IPv4 and IPv6. New IP and GET checks are advisory. Header presence is not required, and the original device and trusted proxy cannot be proven.
The existing source-specific impression field limits and reporting advice remain. No conversion-only field limits or defaults are imposed on impression pixels.
Configured reporting fields, OEM methodology, household matching, playback timing, macro generation, account ownership and delivery require external context.

review_notes: Primary PDF text was read through web extraction. Direct downloads returned HTTP 502 and PDF screenshots were unavailable. No visual table review or binary PDF hash is claimed.
Seven synthetic HTML image controls instantiate published templates; they are not SDK executions and prove no collector acceptance. Every browser request was intercepted.
Source snapshots remain local and are not distributed. Product provenance contains URLs, snapshot hashes, scope limits and synthetic fixtures.
Other candidates lacked new transport proof. Script loader field count alone was not treated as a defect.
